raw_segments.text: Noon slumbers. Kevin Egan rolls gunpowder cigarettes through
fingers smeared with printer's ink, sipping his green fairy as Patris is white.
About us gobblers fork spiced beans down their gullets.
Undemi Sadier. A jet of coffee steam from the burnished cauldron.
She serves me at his beck. Il est Erlandeis. Hollandeis. Non-frommage.
Do you Erlandeis, noose, Erlande, vous, save as ah, we?
She thought you wanted to cheese Hollandeis. You're post-prandial, do you know that word?
Post-prandial.
There was a fellow I knew once in Barcelona, queer fellow, used to call it his post-prandial.
Well, slant. Around the slab tables the tangle of whined breaths and grumbling gorges.
His breath hangs over our saucy-stained plates, the green fairies fang thrusting between his lips.
Of Ireland the Dalcations of hopes, conspiracies of Arthur Griffith now,
a e-pimander good shepherd of men. To yoke me as his yoke-fellow are crimes our common cause.
You're your father's son. I know the voice.
His fustian shirt, sanguine-flowered, trembles at Spanish tassels at his secrets.
M. Drumont, famous journalist. Drumont, know what he called Queen Victoria.
Old hag with the yellow teeth. Veal ogress with the dense johns.
Mod gone, beautiful woman la patri. M. millivoy, phalanx fora, know how he died.
Licentious men. The frokin, bonnet-out fair, who rubs male nakedness in the bath at Uppsala.
Mois fair, she said, twos less maisieurs. Not this monsieur, I said. Most licentious custom.
Bath the most private thing. I wouldn't let my brother, not even my own brother,
most lascivious thing. Green eyes, I see you. Fang, I feel. Lascivious people.
